title: An Okay *KID* Chair - Not for Adults
text: An Okay *KID* Chair - Not for Adults. In the product details, it says it’s for 7-12 year olds, so all the reviews stating it was much smaller than expected must not have read. My kid is young and this chair works out fine. It’s a decent size for them. The padding is kind of thin and it isn’t the sturdiest. It is just an average, get what you pay for type of chair. Nothing fancy, just gets the job done.
